newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Central Puerto to build $235 mln plant.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Central Puerto to build $235 mln plant.

text.p: Argentine utility Central Puerto, controlled by a consortium headed by Chile's Chilgener SA, Friday announced it ordered the building of a $235 million, 769 MW combined cycle plant.

The company said in a press release it signed a contract with General Electric Power Systems and the local Techint Compania Tecnica Internacional to build and maintain the plant, twice as big as originally planned, in Buenos Aires.
The deal replaces a previous one signed in November with the same companies to build a $140 million, 382 MW plant.
Central Puerto said it is well advanced in talks with the U.S. Eximbank to get 12-year financing of about 70 percent of the total required investment.
With the new plant, Central Puerto will have an installed capacity of 2,148 MW or 20 percent of Argentina's total electricity demand, the company said.
